name: freeinference-companion
description: FreeInference skill package for Codex: manual provider diagnostics and model discovery. It does not install automatic lifecycle telemetry; Codex context and cache measurements are unavailable. Community-built and unofficial. Not affiliated with or endorsed by FreeInference.

interface.shortDescription: Manual FreeInference diagnostics and model discovery for Codex.
interface.longDescription: Community-built skill package for FreeInference-powered Codex sessions. Runs user-requested provider diagnostics and model discovery without installing lifecycle hooks, adding inference traffic, or acting as a proxy. Context and cache metrics are unavailable because this package receives no Codex telemetry stream.
defaultPrompt: Check FreeInference service status and provider configuration.
